design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned (1:1 ratio in permuted blocks of four, stratified by age and steroid dependence) using a computer-generated random number sequence.

domain_judgments.rationale: Allocation sequence was computer-generated, concealed via sequentially numbered opaque sealed envelopes by independent personnel, and baseline characteristics were comparable between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Personnel not caring for these patients used computer-generated random number sequence to prepare strata-wise lists and concealed the allocation in sequentially numbered, opaque sealed envelopes that were opened at randomization.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was open-label, one randomized participant was excluded from the primary modified intention-to-treat analysis because they did not receive the intervention, and five participants in the tacrolimus group had non-compliance issues.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Modified intention-to-treat analysis included all patients who received at least one dose of either intervention following randomization... one patient assigned to rituximab did not return after randomization.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were available for 40 of 41 randomized participants (nearly all participants), with only a single participant lost immediately post-randomization without receiving treatment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Modified intention-to-treat population included 40 patients; one patient assigned to rituximab did not return after randomization. No other patient was lost to follow-up.

domain_judgments.rationale: Remission and relapse were assessed using objective clinical definitions based on standard urine dipstick proteinuria criteria, unlikely to be influenced by lack of blinding.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Parents examined the first morning urine using dipstick and recorded details of proteinuria, infections, adverse events, and medication doses in a diary, which was reviewed at each visit... Relapse (recurrence of 3 +/4 + proteinuria for ≥ 3 days) was treated with prednisolone...

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered with predefined primary and secondary outcomes, which are fully reported according to the specified analysis plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Following approval from the Institute Ethics Committee (IECPG-390/30.08.2018, RT-4/27.09.2018), the trial was registered at the Clinical Trials Registry of India (CTRI/2018/11/016342) and conducted according to the original protocol.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged as some concerns due to potential bias arising from deviations from intended interventions in an open-label trial with post-randomization exclusion of one patient from the primary modified intention-to-treat analysis.

design_rationale: The authors explicitly describe the study as a prospective randomized study in which 51 children were randomized to cyclophosphamide, tacrolimus, or rituximab.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study states participants were randomized, but provides no details on sequence generation or allocation concealment methods.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A prospective randomized study of 51 children with FRSDNS not previously treated with steroid-sparing agents were randomized to cyclophosphamide, tacrolimus, or rituximab.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was open-label without blinding of patients or carers, which could potentially influence co-interventions or self-reported outcomes, though treatments followed standard clinical protocols.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients completed 6–8 doses of IV cyclophosphamide... Children received tacrolimus, 0.1–0.15 mg/kg per day... Children were scheduled to receive a single-dose of rituximab...

domain_judgments.rationale: All 51 randomized participants (17 per group) were accounted for in the 1-year analysis with complete follow-up.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: 51 FRSDNS children not previously treated with steroid-sparing agents were randomized to receive rituximab, cyclophosphamide, or tacrolimus... Treatment Cyclophosphamide N=17, Tacrolimus N=17, Rituximab N=17

domain_judgments.rationale: Objective clinical outcomes (relapse rate, lab values) are unlikely to be biased, but patient/parent-reported HRQOL outcomes could be influenced by lack of blinding to the assigned treatment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: HRQOL was evaluated before and 1 year after treatment with these drugs using PedsQL™ 4.0 Generic Core Scales [14, 15].

domain_judgments.rationale: No trial registry number or pre-published protocol is provided to verify that the reported analyses and outcomes were pre-specified.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: At 1 year after treatment, total scores showed greater improvement with rituximab.

overall_summary: The study has some concerns regarding risk of bias overall due to lack of reporting on sequence generation and allocation concealment, an open-label design impacting subjective outcomes like HRQOL, and absence of a pre-registered trial protocol.

design_rationale: The study is an open-label randomized clinical trial in which participants were randomly allocated (1:1) to rituximab or tacrolimus using a web-based stratified block randomization system.

domain_judgments.rationale: Allocation was centrally randomized via a web-based tool using concealed stratified blocks, and baseline characteristics were balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Randomization was performed 1:1 using a web-based tool including stratified block randomization with varying block sizes and sex, age (≤7 vs >7 years), and renal histologic characteristics (minimal change disease vs focal segmental glomerulosclerosis) as stratification factors.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was open-label, but the interventions were delivered according to a standardized protocol without non-protocol deviations that would affect the outcome, and analysis followed the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The trial was open-label, with no masking of patients or study staff to treatment allocation... The primary end point was analyzed using the χ2 test based on the intention-to-treat set.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were available for nearly all participants (only 1 patient had missing primary outcome data, and 3 were lost to follow-up/treatment switched), which is unlikely to bias the results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Of the 176 children screened for eligibility, 120 were randomized and all but 3 patients completed 1 year of follow-up... For 1 patient with missing primary end point information, the most common value in the respective group was imputed.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the study was open-label, relapse and remission were objectively defined based on standardized laboratory and dipstick criteria confirmed by urine protein-creatinine ratios.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Relapse was identified through urine dipstick and confirmed by urine protein-creatinine ratio. Relapse was defined by 3+ or 4+ results on albuminuria dipstick testing for 3 consecutive early-morning specimens, and remission was defined by urine albumin nil or trace results for 3 consecutive early-morning specimens

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered (NCT02438982; CTRI/2014/01/004355) with a prespecified protocol, and outcomes were reported in accordance with the pre-planned analyses.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary end point was the 12-month, relapse-free survival rate. Prespecified key secondary end points were the frequency of relapses, time to first relapse, cumulative prednisolone dosage (milligrams per kilogram per year), changes in serum biochemistry, peripheral blood B-cell count, the number of children not receiving corticosteroids, and the rates of adverse events.

overall_summary: The trial had a low risk of bias across all domains, featuring central concealed web-based randomization, negligible missing outcome data, objective primary outcome measurement, and analysis aligned with a prospectively registered protocol.
